Testing URLs

Review artwork, animation and authored maps. Each page opens in a new tab, keeping your game and this list open.

  • Creature followers

    Every creature's eight directions and idle/walk frames, following the player at gameplay scale. Check turns, stops, backtracking, foreground overlap and reduced motion.

    /creature-follower-preview.html
  • Creature combat animations

    Select a creature and inspect idle, attack, hit, faint and capture states, including calm motion and gameplay scale.

    /creature-combat-preview.html
  • Guardian battle forms

    Compare all four normal and shrine forms side by side at actual battle scale, then inspect every action frame and reduced motion.

    /guardian-combat-preview.html
  • Player and NPC artwork

    The red-cap player's eight directions and walk cycle, plus the reusable traveler and gardener. Compare scale, silhouettes and depth sorting.

    /character-preview.html
  • Player idle poses

    Inspect the neutral standing pose in every facing direction and compare it with the walking poses.

    /player-idle-review.html
  • Map Workshop

    Inspect maps, collision topology and terrain-family artwork. Edits stay in the workshop until you explicitly export or play an edited map.

    /map-editor.html

These pages review the files in your current build; they do not approve artwork or replace a normal playthrough.
